primary_endpoint: Safety outcome and percentage of hepatic fat fraction at 24 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: Hepatic fat fraction changed by −1.55, −0.90, and −1.85 percentage points in Treatment Arms A, B, and C, respectively; statistical comparisons were not reported.
safety_signal: Adverse events affected 17 participants with IMM-124E 600 mg, 14 with 1200 mg, and 13 with placebo. Serious AEs affected 1/43, 2/46, and 3/44, respectively; there were no deaths in the IMM-124E groups and one with placebo.
